rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a discovery, including a notable research finding or a chance discovery.

example.english: This finding made the whole team very excited.
example.traditional: 呢個發現令成個團隊都好興奮。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 faat3 jin6 ling6 sing4 go3 tyun4 deoi6 dou1 hou2 hing1 fan3

rows.note: Use this for the overall result of a study or investigation rather than one particular discovery.

example.english: The finding from this study is summarized in this report.
example.traditional: 呢份報告總結咗今次研究結果。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zung2 git3 zo2 gam1 ci3 jin4 gau3 git3 gwo2

rows.note: Use this when the finding is a concrete item or thing that someone has found.

example.english: The finding was actually my mum’s passport.
example.traditional: 我搵到嘅嘢原來係阿媽本護照。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wan2 dou2 ge3 je5 jyun4 loi4 hai6 aa3 maa1 bun2 wu6 ziu3

rows.note: Use this for a formal ruling by a court, jury, or regulatory body.

example.english: The court announced its finding today.
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 gam1 jat6 gung1 bou3 zo2 coi4 kyut3
